hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1% tax on the WETH/base-asset side of all buys and sells. The tax is minted to the launched token contract as an ERC-6909 claim in the PoolManager. Pool creation is gated to a factory, blocking third-party pool squatting; partial fills on base-asset-specified swaps are rejected to prevent tax overcharging.
